prep.summary: You must prepare for the SVP of insurance product development by highlighting how the new architecture leadership—under RV—is driving a transition to a platform capability strategy and Architecture-as-Code to eliminate tool redundancy and accelerate product delivery. This shift directly addresses critical business pressures—specifically the 70,000 auto policy acquisition deficit and severe cyber uplift bottlenecks delaying digital initiatives up to 18 months—by replacing slow governance with agile guardrails. You will show how architecture now drives value through dynamic capability mapping and automated blast-radius assessments rather than static compliance documents.
tasks: Present the new platform capability mapping strategy led by RV—the incoming SVP of ATS—to demonstrate how it systematically eliminates redundant vendor tools.
Outline the AWS Bedrock enablement path—bypassing lengthy direct master service agreements—to accelerate the deployment of secure AI models for product teams.
Address the 18-month security assessment bottlenecks caused by cyber uplift resource constraints—requiring immediate executive resolution to resume delayed digital initiatives.
Detail the architect capacity constraints within the new claims pod operating model—focusing on prioritizing the adjuster next-best-action queue to offset the 70,000 policy deficit.
